luna_triage.reason: The abstract explicitly says this replicates former results about work stress and short-form ALI, but does not name the original report. The supplied Mauss et al. (2015) row is similar in population and topic, yet evidence does not establish publication-level equivalence or prove it is the specific result retested. Need the cited primary original or evidence tying the former results to this report.
